bullet: Updated:* Starting October 1, 2026, [Compute prices](/compute/resources/pricing#price-changes-from-october-1-2026) changed for VMs with NVIDIA B300, B200, H200 and H100 GPUs, for vCPUs and RAM on the Non-GPU AMD EPYC Genoa platform and for RAM on the Non-GPU Intel Ice Lake platform. Prices for [standalone applications](/applications/standalone/pricing#gpu-prices-from-october-1-2026) with NVIDIA H200 and H100 GPUs changed as well.

Added:* [Spot pricing](/signup-billing/pricing-policy) now applies to preemptible VMs and services that run on them. Nebius sets a current spot price for each preemptible GPU platform, which can change every 15 minutes. When you create a preemptible resource, select a [pricing policy](/signup-billing/manage-pricing-policy) to cap the maximum price, or choose **Follow spot price**. Resources that use a policy stop if the spot price exceeds the max price.

Updated:* Starting June 1, 2026, prices are updated for Compute virtual machines and for Standalone Applications with NVIDIA® B300, B200, H200 and H100 GPUs. To check prices before and from this date, see [Compute documentation](/compute/resources/pricing#prices) and [Standalone Applications documentation](/applications/standalone/pricing#computing-resources).
